import os
from requests.utils import should_bypass_proxies

def test_env_no_proxy(no_proxy_val, url, expected):
    os.environ["no_proxy"] = no_proxy_val if no_proxy_val is not None else ""
    # We pass None to should_bypass_proxies so it uses the environment
    result = should_bypass_proxies(url, None)
    print(f"Env NO_PROXY: {no_proxy_val}, URL: {url}, Expected: {expected}, Result: {result}")
    assert result == expected, f"Failed for Env NO_PROXY: {no_proxy_val}, URL: {url}"

# Clear env first
if "no_proxy" in os.environ: del os.environ["no_proxy"]
if "NO_PROXY" in os.environ: del os.environ["NO_PROXY"]

test_env_no_proxy("example.com", "http://example.com", True)
test_env_no_proxy("example.com", "http://sub.example.com", True)
test_env_no_proxy("example.com", "http://myexample.com", False)
test_env_no_proxy(".example.com", "http://example.com", False)
test_env_no_proxy(".example.com", "http://sub.example.com", True)
test_env_no_proxy(".example.com", "http://myexample.com", False)

print("All env tests passed!")
